timeline.summary: Vadilal Industries reported that an independent audit by a Big 6 firm found no material non-compliance with statutory Minimum Wage Codes across its manufacturing plants.
Vadila Industries Limited reported voting results for remote e‑voting and e‑voting during the EGM held 27 October 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹462.56 Cr, net profit ₹54.82 Cr (+64.0% YoY).
